finalResult.nextParagraphText: Before Jake could say anything, the old man took Jake’s hand as the bench and road made of golden pages disappeared. Instead of the road and bench, Jake now clenched a golden arrow that also seemed to be made of all the compressed pages. It glowed with incredible power and Records that were far beyond Jake’s current understanding.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: The First Sage smiled, and for a moment, his presence changed, catching Jake off guard.
